Preceptor Ryke is a psionics teacher at the . He has class for psionic blocking techniques for students with a PI of seven and above, and another for students of PI six and below.

Solar'a was a Nerazim warrior of the Sari'jal Tribe. She was very close to Aura'Khan, and merged with him to become a dark archon. Solar'a helped recover the terran ghost Nova Terra after she was betrayed by Jackson Hauler. They allowed her to recover, and together worked to undermine Hauler's plan to create spectres from terrazine. In Hauler's base on Char, Solar'a was wounded in a battle against the spectre Vulcan, and merged with Aura'Khan to become a dark archon. Together, they and Nova defeated Vulcan.

Six is a spectre, and was a part of Emperor Arcturus Mengsk's attempts to revive Project Shadowblade. He often smiled, but never with a friendly expression. Though given no real name, his designation was one given by terran reporter Donny Vermillion in order to tell the spectres apart.
The 28-Strand Cable is an attachment for the Crossbow Marksman Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, classed under the exclusive Cable attachment category.
Team Blue was a team of ghost trainees at the . It was led by a young Gabriel Tosh.
Tanya Caulfield, designated Agent X39562B, is a terran ghost. She has a psi index of 5.1, with barely any telepathic ability, but does possess pyrokinetic abilities.
Lightning Beast is Blanka's second V-Trigger in Street Fighter V and Level 2 Super Art in Street Fighter 6.
.30 - 30 Ammo is an attachment exclusive to the MK2 marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Mobile.
The is one of Dudley's special attacks, introduced as his second Super Art in the Street Fighter III series.
Resurrection (リザレクション, Rizarekushon) is one of Gill's Super Arts in the Street Fighter III series. In Street Fighter V, it is his second Critical Art while serving as a boss character in Arcade Mode.

(sometimes credited as Tessyou Genda, Tetsuaki Genda, or Tetsusyo Genda) is a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator. He is employed by the talent management firm 81 Produce. When he debuted, he used his real name, as artist name. Because he had experience with ballet, he was known by the nickname "Pirouette Genda." Genda is one of Japan's most prolific voice actors, with 234 roles credited to his name as of September 25, 2007. Genda has performed the roles of Masami Iwaki (Dokaben), Suppaman (Dr. Slump), Gō Reietsu (High School! Kimengumi), Optimus Prime (A.K.A. Convoy) (The Transformers), Umibouzu (City Hunter), Ichimi Araiwa (Cooking Papa), and Action Kamen (Crayon Shin-chan) and is the current Japanese voice of Tigger in Winnie the Pooh media. He is also known for voicing Kurama in Naruto, and Kaido in One Piece. Like his Canadian counterpart Peter Cullen, Genda reprised the role of Optimus Prime (Convoy) in the Japanese dub of the 2007 Transformers movie. He is best known as the Japanese voice of Batman in numerous animated television series and animated films. Like his American counterpart Kevin Conroy, Genda reprised the role of Batman in the Japanese dub of Batman: Gotham Knight. He voices Kratos in the Japanese versions of the God of War video game series. In February 2010, Genda received a Merit Award from the 4th Seiyu Awards. The 12.7×55 Duplex Ammo is an ammunition attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to the Oden assault rifle. The attachment increases the pellets every shot by 1, resulting in two "bullets" being shot at once, but does not affect the ammunition count. However, it halves the damage of both pellets and decreases ADS accuracy by 30%.
Crushing the Dragon is a throw used by Wang Jinrei from Tekken Tag Tournament onwards.
Double Fist Hammer is a move used by Craig Marduk since Tekken 6.

is an antagonist introduced in the Tekken Spin off game Death by Degrees. A Kometa Executive and master swordsman, Enrique is a major adversary towards Nina during her mission. Although his initial allegiance is with Kometa, he soon grows disillusioned with them and employs the Tekken Force to aid him. An expert with melee weapons, Enrique's signature weapon is a Japanese katana he carries with him everywhere. He also utilizes dual knives and concealed blades in his shoes and also carries a .44 Magnum. He is shown to have enough acrobatic prowess to keep up with Nina, as well as the intelligence to know how much of a threat she is.

The 12.7×55 Subsonic Heavy Ammo is an ammunition attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, exclusive to the Oden assault rifle. It replaces the Oden's regular rounds with heavy subsonic ones that provide sound suppression, similar to the two .300 RTC ammunition attachments of the M13. The ammunition additionally increases the gun's damage range, surface-penetrating prowess and hit flinch, at the cost of reduced bullet velocity.
Eternal Punishment, also nicknamed Asuka's Ultimate Tackle, is a special move exclusively used by Asuka Kazama since Tekken 5.
Flamingo Maelstrom is a move used by Baek Doo San since Tekken 5 .
Jiao Bu Shuang Ba is a move used by Wang Jinrei from Tekken 6 onwards.
The 7.62 40 Round Reload is an ammunition attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to the BK57 assault rifle.

Kuma is the father of Kuma II, and appeared in Tekken and Tekken 2 before he passed away from old age at some point after the second King of Iron Fist Tournament.

Note: As Angel Jin is only playable outside of Story Mode by modding the game, his moves do not have formal names. Left Light Sword is a move used by Angel Jin in Tekken 8 during his playable appearance in the Dark Awakens and as a final boss in the Arcade Mode.

Ogre is a fierce beast said to be left behind by aliens. He has three different forms: *Ancient Ogre - The basic form of Ogre that appeared as the sub-boss of Tekken 3. *True Ogre - The powered up form of Ancient Ogre that appeared as the final boss of Tekken 3. *Monstrous Ogre - The non-canon final form of Ogre that appeared in the Tekken 5 Devil Within mini-game as the final boss.
The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The 556 Icarus is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.

, also known as for short, is a character in the Tekken series who was introduced in Tekken 6 and returned for Tekken 6: Bloodline Rebellion, Tekken 7: Fated Retribution, and Tekken 8 as Season 3 DLC. Bob is a renowned martial arts prodigy from the USA. An alternate version of himself named Slim Bob is playable in Tekken Tag Tournament 2. As the name suggests, he is a skinny version of Bob which first made an appearance in Bob's Tekken 6 ending.

is an Austrian-American bodybuilder, WWE Hall of Famer, Male actor and politician notable for originating the role of the Terminator from the Terminator franchise. Schwarzenegger's portrayal of the Terminator helped earn the character "22nd greatest villain" and "48th greatest hero" of the last 100 years in film on AFI's "100 Years, 100 Heroes and Villains" list.

Six is the sixth T-101 Infiltrator constructed by Serena Burns in 2001. Working in a Secret Terminator Lab constructed under the old Dyson property with the assistance of Third, the process of creation was advanced beyond previous unit’s due to mission requirements. Extra tissue accelerant was introduced into this unit's matrix during growth. Decanted from matrix chamber with a full array of head, facial and body hair, and the physical appearance of a weather-beaten mid-to-late 30's. With the creation of Four through Seven, Serena realized that the simultaneous presence of identical units could compromise infiltration, and initiated a protocol of radical cosmetic alterations to defer suspicions. Six was provided a Desert Eagle .50, Cyberdyne-issued identification as Security Specialist Bob Harris and given concealed carry weapon permits.

The 0M3 '92 Holo is a holographic sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Pistols.

The Defective Male was an 11 year-old I-950 who lost control of his emotions and was subsequently executed as a result. He launched an unprovoked attack upon Thera, a Luddite caretaker, revealing that he despised humans and that he thought of them as nothing more than vermin. His sparring partner, Serena Burns, scolded him for his actions as Thera was Skynet's property and he was not ordered to attack her in the first place. He then claimed that Skynet allowed him to do whatever he wants; a claim Serena knew to be false. When the boy tried to kill Thera, Serena threw him across the room and then proceeded to beat him into submission and, after asking Skynet's advice, killed him. His actions disturbed Serena and prompted her to seek out a Luddite scientist in order to understand what made him so defective. He also served as a cautionary warning to the other I-950s.
The T-600 was a T-600 Terminator patrolling in the ruins of Los Angeles.

"One" is the first T-101 Infiltrator constructed by Serena Burns in 2001 in a Secret Terminator Lab constructed under the old Dyson property. The process of creation would take two months from start to finish. The Terminator was terminated by the Connors with multiple shots from a Barrett .50 caliber sniper rifle and a Gustav 84mm recoilless rifle.

The 6.5mm Sakura Mags is a set of Magazine attachments in Call of Duty: Vanguard. They function primarily as a "smaller caliber" option for a majority of weapons, similar to that of the 7.62mm Gorenko Mags, providing an increase in control and increasing firing concealment. But at the cost of reducing the overall damage that the weapon does. Weaponry that has natively uses 6.5mm Sakura instead can use it in various forms, primarily in Extended Mags or Fast Mag styles.

Paul Drake was an assistant of Professor Henry Raffelson in the year 2000. He was a Tubular Corporation employee assigned to Shelter 65. He started to undergo mutations due to a failed experiment, became severely crazed, and began attacking his fellow employees. He later encountered the Megaforce, and attacked them with a sub-machine gun. He was quickly subdued and interrogated. He mockingly told the mercenaries that they were going to die. When questioned by Commander Dalton Bond, he cryptically replied: "They know you're coming...and they're waiting for you!" After Dr. Sara Drumble recognized him, he let out a high-pitched wail that stunned and disoriented the soldiers. By the time the wail ceased, he had disappeared, along with Megaforce operative Price. He was never seen again, although it is assumed he mutated into a creature, or perished when the Tubular Plant exploded due to Samuel Fuller's sabotage.

Rev-9 is an advanced Terminator and Infiltrator series utilized by Legion in the Dark Fate timeline. A Rev-9 consists of a traditional, solid carbon-based endoskeleton covered by an outer sheath made of advanced carbon-based mimetic polyalloy. In addition, the Rev-9 possesses the ability to distinctly separate into two independent units.

Saboteurs are assault units constructed by the Resistance during the Future War. These machines would fight in the Resistance's command. However, when they were relocated to another dimension, it was thought they would be lost forever. The Saboteurs soon came back to their original dimension to turn against Resistance soldiers and target anything on their path.

141 may refer to: *Task Force 141 - A task force present in the original Modern Warfare series. *Intervention (weapon) - A sniper rifle referred to as the TF-141 in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. *Task Force 141 (Reboot) - A task force present in the rebooted Modern Warfare series. *Kilo 141 - An assault rifle introduced in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. *141 (song) - A song from the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II soundtrack. *141 Training Week - A seasonal event in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
RoboCop 2 is a cyborg designed by Omni Consumer Products as the successor to the RoboCop. It was used to house the brain of the deceased drug lord Cain, hence the cyborg is also known as RoboCain.

The T-799 Cyborg Prototype Series "Eve" is the precursor to the T-800 Terminator. It is developed by Skynet in 2026 from the original timeline and later Skynet's World. The T-799 was a slower model than the T-800 and less intelligent. The T-799 was used from 2026 to 2029 and was then used mostly for guarding the Terminator factories. Eve's appearance and voice are based on Sergeant Helen Wolfe, a Resistance combatant killed by a Hunter-Killer on the Canadian west coast.

The CSM-104 T-803 Light Assault Infiltrator is a variant of the Series 800 Terminatrix developed by Skynet. The T-803 unit is equipped with Retractable Claws. The T-803 Infiltrators are similar to the T-800 except they are patterned after females.

The is an assault rifle featured in many games of the Modern Warfare and Black Ops series, as well as in Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Heroes, Rightful King, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The Cyberdyne Systems Series 100 Robotic Infantry Unit is a humanoid Hunter-Killer deployed by Skynet in the early stages of the war.

Rhee has played various henchmen, supporting characters and been a fighting trainer for various celebrities on various film and TV show productions. Rhee contributed stunts on and doubled Byung-hun Lee in .
The Cyberdyne Systems Series 000 Sweeper Unit, or T-000, also known as "Triple Zero" and "Sweeper", is a humanoid Hunter-Killer deployed by Skynet 2.0 in the late stages of the war.

The is a weapon appearing as a submachine gun in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, and as an assault rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It is also found in the game files of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, and makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

The "Water Delivery Guy" was a Series 888 Infiltrator sent to terminate Catherine Weaver and, presumably, her daughter Savannah Weaver. He also likely had affiliation with the present time Kaliba Group, who were working with/under control of Skynet.

Guts is a monster that attaches itself to a wall or obstacle, such as a rock, rolling around the contour of the terrain. If the obstacle it is attached to is destroyed, then it will continue rolling in the direction it was previously traveling until it meets another wall or obstacle. They make up for their limited movement by being very fast, and in numbers they can tighten movement space (especially in layouts containing narrow passages). Two of them are spawned by Mama Guts upon death. __TOC__

Kalgoron is a guard in the Wrath of the Spider Queen. Velma said to Curtis and Kalgoron that she wanted to sample her cake with Grim's head on top of the cake. Kalgoron fights for the cake and said that it was his "honor" from Curtis. Curtis wins the fight and takes the cake. es:Kalgoron

The is a STOVL ground-attack aircraft that appears in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, as well as being cut from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. The Harrier is used by the United States Marine Corps to support their amphibious landing operations. They usually carry out airstrikes against enemy fortifications and units in support of friendlies. As a VTOL aircraft, it is capable of hovering in place, much like a helicopter.

Adar was a mysterious individual of the Second Age referred to as Lord-father by Orcs, presumably for his status as one of the Moriondor, the first Elves to be captured and tortured by Morgoth. Galadriel initially thought that Moriondor was a lieutenant in Sauron's army after the War of Wrath, when Sauron allegedly ruled as the "new Dark Lord". But this belief was later disproved by revealing that Sauron only claimed to be crowned and was killed instead, for his cruel magic "experiments" with Uruk blood. Believing himself free from Sauron's grasp, Adar sought to fashion a home where the Uruk (Orcs) could thrive. With the use of a mysterious hilt and his "children", he claimed the Southlands and turned them into Mordor. Word of Sauron's return, however, spurred Adar into action. Hoping to destroy Sauron once and for all, Adar assembled an army and laid siege to Eregion. In the end, he was betrayed and slain by a group of his own "children", who embraced Sauron as their new Dark Lord.
Bandobras Took, commonly known as Bullroarer, was a Hobbit of the Shire and the hero of the Battle of the Green Fields.

attacked by a Barrow-wight|245x245px]] The Barrow-wights were types of Undead-like beings made up of dead bones animated by evil spirits. They dwelt in dark places of Eriador such as the Barrow-downs and were similar in disposition to Wraiths.

The is a fighter aircraft featured in Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Vanguard. The plane is used by the Imperial Japanese Navy in the Pacific Theater during World War II.

Brenna was a Dwarf-woman of Khazad-dûm in the Second Age. She was present when Disa sang to the mountain, pleading for the return of several miners trapped following a shaft collapse. Some time later, after an earthquake caused by Orodruin's eruption, she used her voice along with Disa and another Stone-singer, Revna, to attempt to reopen a collapsed light-passage.

Círdan, also known as Nowë and Círdan the Shipwright, was one of the highest and noblest of the Sindar, Lord of the Falathrim during the First Age, and Master of the Grey Havens through the Second, Third, and Fourth Age. He was one of the wisest and most clairvoyant of the Elves, and by the Second Age the oldest known elf in Middle-earth, to remain so throughout that age and into the Fourth Age as well. He was also gifted Narya, one of the Three Rings, by Celebrimbor until he surrendered it to Gandalf. He was one of the last Elves to leave Middle-earth, sailing West some time after the death of King Elessar in FO 120.

"Cold be hand and heart and bone," was the first line of an incantation sung by the Barrow-wight that trapped Frodo Baggins, Meriadoc Brandybuck, Peregrin Took, and Samwise Gamgee in its barrow after they left Tom Bombadil's house. When Frodo first heard it, it was no more than a murmur, but soon manifested as a song of horrible sounds and cold words before changing into an incantation that chilled him to the bone.
The (Adaptive Combat Rifle) is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was cut from Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

The Cargûl were wraiths of Angmar created by the Morgul-blades of the Nazgûl. Dressed in crimson robes and carrying long swords, these creatures patrol Carn Dûm, and also appear at Angmarim. The Cargûl were created for and are only in The Lord of the Rings Online.
Malbeth the Seer was a Dúnadan of Arnor, and a royal counsellor of Arthedain who lived in the time of kings Araphant and Arvedui. Per his name, he was known for his powers of a seer.

Lungorthin was the second Balrog-lord and a thane of Morgoth who appeared in The Lay of the Children of Húrin. He was initially one of the Maiar who gave their allegiance to Melkor. Like Gothmog, Lungorthin bore the title of "Lord of Balrogs", though Lungorthin was the lesser of the two, and not a High-captain of Angband. He participated in the Nírnaeth Arnoediad bearing whistling whips, where he aided Gothmog in the slaying of Fingon, restraining him in a throng of steel, giving Gothmog the chance to slay him. After this battle, Gothmog captured Húrin, bringing the man to Angband where, before Morgoth, Lungorthin used his whistling whip that burned to smite Húrin on the mouth while he was being interrogated.

Mell is a Silvan Elf and is a magic wielder in Thranduil Halls. She is married to Gwendil. She is the deuteragonist of the 2023 game .

Revna was a Dwarf-woman of Khazad-dûm in the Second Age. After an earthquake, she used her voice along with the other Stone-singers, Disa and Brenna to attempt find a new path through the rock for sunlight to enter the city.
Sylphs was the name of one of the many Sprites of ancient Arda, as recorded in the earliest forms of Tolkien's Mythology. They were known as the Fays of the air.

The AN-94 is an assault rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
Sáyar was the name of one of the many Sprites of ancient Arda, as recorded in the earliest forms of Tolkien's Mythology. They were known as the "Fays of the fire".

Skalhelm was a female Nazgûl. She is armed with a heavy bow, "Stalker's Bow", which is her relic. Skalhelm was a great leader of the Dúnedain of Arnor before she met Sauron, the "Lord of Gifts", and accepted one of the Rings of Power delivered to Men. She is now serving the One Ring, and her ranger abilities are invaluable to the Nine. Skalhelm made a point to be on the front lines with her men when securing Arnor's borders. As such, she knew a lot about the lands and was a great hunter. She now has been serving the One for more than 4000 years.
Thorin III "Stonehelm" was the son and heir of Dáin II of Durin's Folk, who was king of the Dwarves of Erebor and the Iron Hills in Rhovanion.

The AK-74 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It also makes brief cameo appearances in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Thorin II "Oakenshield", eventually called King under the Mountain or Mountain King, was the son of Thráin II, the older brother of Frerin and Dís, the grandson of King Thrór and the uncle of Fíli and Kíli. Thorin was best known for his deeds as leader of a company that infiltrated the lost Kingdom under the Mountain to take it back from Smaug and for leading an alliance of Men, Dwarves, and Elves in the Battle of Five Armies.

Tom, Bert, and William "Bill" Huggins were three trolls encountered by Bilbo Baggins in the Trollshaws west of the Misty Mountains, while with Thorin and Company on their quest to regain the Lonely Mountain. Like most of their kind outside of Mordor, they were vagabonds who robbed, stole, and killed for what they needed or wanted. They were destroyed by sunlight which turned them to stone with the aid of Gandalf's trickery.

In an early stage of J.R.R. Tolkien's mythology, Thû was a temporary replacement of the villain Tevildo, Lord of Cats. He was known as the "Lord of werewolves" and "Necromancer", and was a precursor to the character Sauron. ]]

Ugthak was an Uruk-hai Berserker of Isengard in the video game . He was armed with two axes that were augmented by Saruman to remain in a state of extreme heat.

Wraiths, also known as the Houseless and the Unbodied, are beings who were killed yet remain in existence by some dark sorcery such as necromancy or a Morgul-blade, or someone who died in darkness or serious dishonor.

The Ñoldor (Quenya: "Deep Ones", meaning "those with knowledge"; singular Ñoldo), also known as the Deep-elves, were the second clan of the Elves that came to the West in the Great March. According to legend, they were originally among the Tatyar, meaning "Second Ones". This tribe was begun by Tata, the second Elf to awake at Cuiviénen, along with his wife Tatië and their 54 companions — but the first Ñoldo to come to Valinor was Finwë, who became their king and led most to the Undying Lands. However, fully half the Tatyar refused the call of the Valar and thus became counted among the Avari. The Ñoldor who came to Aman spoke Quenya, or, more specifically, its Ñoldorin dialect. They were also called the Sword-elves, Aulendur ("Servants of Aulë"), Noldoli or Gnomes, Golodhrim in Sindarin, and Golug in the Black Speech. The singular form of Ñoldor is Ñoldo and the adjective Ñoldorin. They were the Second Clan of the Elves in both order and size, the other clans being the Vanyar and Teleri. They typically had dark hair, except for those of Vanyarin blood, most prominently the golden-haired members of the House of Finarfin. The Ñoldor were considered the greatest of the Elves in lore and craft. Fëanor was the greatest of their artisans, and their second and briefest-reigning King. Bill Stickers was a villain — a figure in a "long-running family epic" told by J.R.R. Tolkien to his children. The stories "revolved around the tireless efforts of Major Road Ahead to prosecute the villain". Bill Stickers was an "irrepressible villain" and "a huge hulk of a man who always got away with everything".
Dumbledors were a legendary "ferocious race of winged insects", mentioned only in Hobbit verse. The dumbledors were said to have battled a knight on a quest.

Dorongúr Whitethorn is an Elf and one of the original inhabitants of Edhelion. He fought in the Battle of Edhelion and defended the gate against Dourhands and Goblins. Eventually a Snow-troll destroyed the gate and attempted to kill Dorongúr and his companions, including the player, but they were rescued by Elrond who killed the Troll. Dorongúr led Elrond and the player to the place where they saw that Skorgrím Dourhand and two Dourhands had surrounded Talagan Silvertongue, the lord of Edhelion. Talagan Silvertongue, in attempt to protect Edhelion's relics, destroys the entrance of the palace in which not only the Dourhands die, but Talagan himself too. Dorongúr and the survivors of Edhelion leave the city, on Elrond's counsel. Unlike many of the other survivors Dorongúr does not sail to Valinor but remains in Middle-earth. Eventually after six centuries Dorongúr leads a company of Elves, against the counsel of Elrond, to Edhelion and with the aid of Dorollas and the player attempts to restore the city. But the city is befouled by many evils and soon was attacked by a group of Goblins. Eventually it was discovered that the Goblins were allied with Angmar and the Dourhands, who wanted to revive Skorgrím Dourhand. Dorongúr leads the Elves and a company of Longbeards in war against the Goblins and the Dourhands and drive them from Thorin's Gate, while Dwalin and the player try to stop the reviving of Skorgrím, but they fail. The is an armored fighting vehicle designed to transport infantry to the battlefield.

Daurin, also called Tórin, was a Gnome of the Elder Days. He was notable for attacking Melko and Gwerlum when they were attempting to destroy the Two Trees. After he had cut off one of Gwerlum's legs, she threw a web around him and Melko killed him. He then took his blade, which was laced with the black, poisonous blood of Gwerlum, and proceeded to destroy the other tree, Silpion.

The Iathrim or Elves of Doriath were those Sindar that lived in the broad forests of central Beleriand, Neldoreth, and Region, under the Kingship of Elu Thingol and later Dior Eluchíl. These people, whose Queen was of the order of the Maiar and whose King was the High King of the Sindar, were held to be the highest and noblest of the Grey-elven kindred. The Marchwardens were those Elves assigned to guarding the borders of the forest of Doriath. After the Ruin of Doriath, Elwing led the survivors to the Mouths of Sirion.

Jäänainen was an evil Maia invented by Iron Crown Enterprises for Middle-earth Role Playing. In the First Age, she was allied with Morgoth, and she fled far north after the War of Wrath. Biding her time, she performed smaller evils, igniting feuds or luring men to their death by assuming the form of a beautiful woman. In the Third Age, she dwelt near the Bay of Cracking Ice. While her petty evils pleased the Witch-king, like many of the evil spirits of the Northern Waste, she was not in any way subservient to him or Sauron. The ABR 223 is a three-round burst bullpup tactical rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
Agoston the Younger is a Tzimisce elder and the sire of Jehan du Pleaux.
Akuji is an eleventh-generation Nosferatu storyteller and a trusted vassal of Lord Jürgen of Magdeburg.

Ambrosio Luis Monçada was a powerful Lasombra, the sire of the famous Lucita de Aragón, his favorite childe, and María Sandoza, the Grand Inquisitor of the Sabbat Inquisition. He was Archbishop of Madrid, Spain, until his death, whereupon Lucita succeeded him. He made his haven at the famed church. He later became a cardinal and thus became known derogatorily as Cardinal Maledictus Sanguine (lit. "Cardinal of the Blood Curse"). Monçada viewed his Embrace as God's will, and through the instrument of the Curse of Caine, he had all of eternity to do the Lord's work. He was a follower of the Path of Power and the Inner Voice and attests to True Faith. Aside from confessions, he confined himself mostly to his haven, until his Final Death on October 6, 1999.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Alexander, frequently called Alexander of Paris for being the longtime Prince of that city after the fall of Rome, was a 4th generation Ventrue Embraced as a youth by the Ventrue Antediluvian in Ancient Greece and ultimately destroyed in 1232 CE by the Gangrel warlord Qarakh, while the latter was infused by the power of the Baltic deity Telyavel.
Ana Rita Montaña is a 9th generation Tzimisce resident of Mexico City.

The Ama-San are a compact of hunters who specialize in pursuing sea monsters. Like Japanese pearl-divers, the matriarchal Ama-San use a distinctive cry called the isobue or "sea-whistle" to regulate their breathing when they surface. Unlike their colleagues, they have learned to use the sea-whistle to force undersea creatures to the surface where they can be destroyed.
The [http://kitsunesden.xyz/Firearms/Auto-Rifles/K-VAR_AKU-94.htm AKBP Tech] is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online.

Alex Cassel is the "Prexy" of the electrokinetics in Trinity and the CEO of Orgotek. Cassel, born into wealth, laid the foundations of Orgotek while he was in college. He founded a holding company, World Enterprises, Inc., and filled the board with his friends (including then-girlfriend Ellayne Chen, who he later married). After his triggering, Cassel turned his attention to the biotech industry, and grew Orgotek into one of the most profitable corporations in the Federated States of America. Cassel dreams of a human race prospering in every sense of the word: free of aberrants and other menaces, expanding through the universe, living long, full, satisfying lives. Cassel wants to abolish tyranny and poverty and everything else that keeps people from fulfilling their dreams. And he’s willing to do almost anything to make all this happen. Alex Cassel’s moral code revolves around these plans for humanity. He condones subterfuge, theft and even killing, but he is nonetheless an idealist. The Prexy wants to build a peaceful, prosperous future; he doesn’t sit in a board room and declare hits like a mob boss. He has heroic and humanitarian goals, but his actions can pose moral quandaries for his allies and followers.

Alma Bedford is a draugr defined primarily by her greed. Flush with wealth, Bedford, before succumbing entirely to the Beast, had all of those assets converted into cash and dumped into the basement of her estate. Bedford then had her retainers killed and her estate demolished. There, the money lingers, inaccessible to her, yes, but also to anyone else.
Alexios was a Fenrir who led Heinrik's pack, the Cult's representation in the Pioneer Valley, to its destruction.
Abandon Ship is the Main Quest for the map Voyage of Despair, in which the characters of the Chaos Story must complete the trial set out by the Sentinel Artifact.
Aline Gädeke is a powerful Brujah and the Anarch Baron of Mannheim.

Amadose is a Tzimisce fleshcrafter of the Sabbat. When the Nosferatu Qui was captured by the Sabbat, Amadose used their talents of Vicissitude to experiment upon Qui and transform his appearance to that of a cainite not affected by the Nosferatu Clan Curse.

André Joseph Corbin, a Scottish soccer player, erupted as a nova and joined Team Tomorrow as "Bender" due to his powers of emotional manipulation. However, Corbin wasn't much of a team player, and was eventually kicked off the Team after the infamous incident where he threw a pie in the face of Caestus Pax. He kept close ties with Jennifer "Slider" Landers, however, and was one of the few people she trusted with her secret: awareness of the conspiracy within Project Utopia calling itself Proteus. This knowledge led to her death, for which Corbin was blamed. Corbin went into hiding and, with the help of Sophia Rousseau, founded the Aberrants.
The ARAV is an armored vehicle in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Blackout mode. First introduced in Operation Absolute Zero, it is a 3-seat off-road combat vehicle.
Anjalika Underwood is one of the few surviving Ravnos in the Final Nights.
Andrew Emory is a Lasombra who uses the tentacles called forth with Obtenebration to carry himself, as he is disabled.

Anja Silverclaws is a No Moon caste Lunar, recently Exalted in the Age of Sorrows. She is the signature No Moon. Young Anja is the reincarnation of the famous and prophetic First Age elder Ingosh Silverclaws, and takes her name after him. Some older Lunars consider her presumptuous for assuming the name of her mighty past life at such a young age.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

An Ananke is a spirit-like being created by an archmaster of Fate and Time, tasked to ensure that its creator's prophecies come true, or that his descendants are alerted of magical dangers that the mage obscured.

Andrew Stevens was a Southern plantation owner of Georgia in life, who killed himself after his the love his life rejected him. As a wraith, he became an Anacreon for the Silent Legion in the Atlanta Necropolis.
Angus is a Werewolf. Quote: Everyday, people like you walk right by people like me without a second glance. I recommend that you do it right now.
The is an integrally suppressed assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Anahita is a Defiler in Los Angeles. Anahita is possessing the body of a mortal known as Barbie Wentworth.

Antal Garaboncias is a Tremere war-wizard and the Regent of Brandenburg an der Havel, during the Medieval period. He was part of the coterie put together by Jervais to enter Livonia and destroy the Telyavelic Tremere.

Angharad is a powerful mortal from Medieval Wales and the wife of Rhys ap Ieuan. It is later discovered that she has been reborn over many lifetimes during a thousand years to manipulate one Kindred of prophecy as mandated by her master Joseph of Arimathea.

AMR may refer to: *AMR9 (Advanced Warfare) - A submachine gun in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. *AMR9 (Modern Warfare III) - A submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *Rytec AMR - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile. *KATT-AMR - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *HAMR - A light machine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *AMR Mod 4 - The Barrett .50cal as it is called in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

Arnaguatsaaq "Chill That Waits" was an Inuit Homid (breed) Wendigo who lived at during the time that the Wendigo first arrived in the Americas. She fought a giant sea squid named Luumajuuq, or Ice Breaker, using a carved bone weapon that she received upon waking up from a dream about the monster. She also fought many of the minions of the Wyrm, including the giant bird, Aipalloovik, and bound others deep beneath the ice. Her knife, supposedly a gift from Luna, has been lost to time, though many packs have searched for it. Some claim that her spirit is the special protector of the Inuit and special advisor to the leaders of Nunavut, Canada.

Antoine was a young and wealthy Lasombra of the Medieval era. He was a caravan master working with the powerful Brujah Rodrigo. When one of the caravans was raided by Tremere and Rodrigo's manuscripts were stolen, the Brujah came to Antoine seeking answers. Rodrigo gave in to his inner Beast, and beat up and diablerized Antoine.

Anton Wellig is a powerful Fifth Generation Tremere and the childe of Meerlinda. In 1888, he assisted Valerius in his attempt to kill Prince Mithras, by using Emma Blake as a vessel for poisoned blood, but the methuselah Kemintiri interrupted their ritual.

The AA Technical was an unused vehicle featured in the Multiplayer mode of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was intended to be used in the Ground War and Invasion modes before being entirely removed from the game on January 1st, 2024.

Antoine de St. Lys was the Lasombra Cainite Heresy Bishop of Paris, and a rival of the Malkavian Anatole. A Blood Hunt against led him to flee into the , and the bishop is destroyed by the Holy Ground.
Anwar al-Beshi was a Setite sorcerer of Cairo, during the Victorian Age. While performing a ritual with his ghouls Fahd and Emma Blake, he was stopped and destroyed by the Gangrel Cuthbert Beckett.
Apollonius of Tyana is a Greek magus and healer from ancient times. His figure became the prophet of the Kindred cult, the Serapis Ex Machina.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Arthur Laurence is a Wraith, the deceased husband of Una Laurence.

Artemisia, the wife of Mausolus, was the woman who oversaw the completion of the Mausoleum, interring her husband in it. Following her own death, she too was interred there. At some point after their deaths but during the age of the Web of Seven, the two separately rose as Prometheans and began their Pilgrimages.

Augustus was a Roman nobleman and Vampire, Embraced at the fall of his beloved Roman Empire. He was embraced into the Road of the Beast but soon developed a new path within: the Path of the Grey Hunter.

The is a British truck and medium artillery tractor built for British and Commonwealth forces during World War II. It appears as a prop in the maps London Docks, Egypt, Excavation and Dunkirk. Some are destroyed while others are used as part of platforms with other vehicles.
Ashur-uballit is a powerful Hecata master of Abyss Mysticism, and a Sabbat Cardinal.
Arthur Carroll is a powerful Brujah and the first Prince of Washington, D.C..

Azrael, known as the Throne of Release, Alabaster Lord, and Angel of the Shadow, is an Earthbound of the Seventh House and one of the five Archdukes who commanded the infernal legions during the War of Wrath. As leader of the Alabaster Legion, he was responsible for protecting humanity from the consequences of mortality and preserving the souls of those claimed by death. Although initially devoted to humanity's salvation, Azrael eventually abandoned Lucifer's authority and supported the conspiracy of Abaddon and Asmodeus. Following his imprisonment in the Abyss and subsequent return to Creation, he established an extensive network of death cults that promised their followers spiritual enlightenment while binding their souls to his service.
The is a marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Ball-biter is a lupus Ahroun Black Fury in Australia. She and her pack target rapists.
Baldric LaSalle bani Quaesitor, was a mage of the Order of Hermes, and a founder of the Council of Nine Mystic Traditions.

Aziz is a 11th generation Malkavian, who is known as the Prince of Riddles, who has a small portion of the essence of a djinn within him, focusing his thoughts after his Embrace. Aziz hopes to find the elusive answers to the Eternal Riddle. He is one of a select few who has achieved Golconda.

The Accu-Spot Ultra Holo is a holographic sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Pistols.

Ava is a Garou of the Caern of Tarker's Mill and a computer specialist. She rises to lieutenant of Rodko's pack after Cahal Filin exiles himself following the death of his wife, Ludmila. Following his departure she founds Lambda Mankind, a human eco-terrosim group to aid the caern in it's struggle against Endron.

The Baalim were predecessors to the Scelesti who were active during the . Outside of ancient settlements like Babylon, Baalim tended to operate alone, and rarely were they seen as any kind of pressing threat by Awakened society at large. Much like their successors, Baalim were known to invite Paradoxes into their spellwork so as to strengthen it. Their Yantras typically invoked distorted symbols, with paradoxical logic and impossible geometry.

Balthazar Richter is a 18th Century Missionary sent by the Society of Jesus to China. He disappeared after a decade in the area. He has been seen through the years and is rumored to have fallen to the enemy and is now a Vampire.
A Tank Ride is the tenth track of the Origins (Original Game Soundtrack). It is composed by Brian Tuey, with a runtime of 2:33.
